items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Shafi Hadi was one of the sidemen, you know, same as I was. I was a sideman then.

ctx.x: I’m trying to think of who you’re referring to was on that first date? Because I had first gigs, that I call first gigs.
Shafi Hadi, Pepper Adams, Wynton Kelly.
Who was the leader for that?
